extension.news: 2026.08.22 - Bundled menu, genre, and cached artist icons load on Android/Linux: local paths that start with / are no longer rewritten as musicmp3.ru URLs (thanks to adamsbuilds). 2026.08.19 - Album download folders include the release year (Album (1979)) so same-artist, same-title albums no longer overwrite each other. 2026.07.20 - Harden audio downloads: atomic .part handoff, validate status/size/magic bytes, skip failed album tracks. See the changelog. Enjoy!
